repair_obligation_closure.rule: P3_1 must resolve every frozen atomic assertion to a concrete executable check and source/evidence schema, independently review and re-lock before VERIFY. The final aggregator rejects missing or duplicate atomic IDs, check mappings, any required current proof level, wrong candidate/Run or unavailable raw evidence; a name or fixture alone is never host proof. Required maintenance proof rejects empty knowledgeIds, null/missing linkedReceipt or operationKey and mismatched original publication, source, audience or operation; originRunId alone does not qualify. Registration means tested executable definitions, immutable code versions and protected evidence schemas; final-candidate business execution and source attestation occur in VERIFY after P5. P4_3 construction artifact can unblock P5_1 only; it is not a final result. VERIFY may start on PREVERIFY_IMPLEMENTATION_READY for P3_1 and P4_3 only after the full readiness conditions and all other DAG prerequisites; it then performs final evidence closure.
